words: Der Zug kommt um acht Uhr.
The train arrives at eight o'clock.
Der Zug fährt von Gleis drei.
The train leaves from platform three.
Von welchem Gleis fährt der Zug?
Which platform does the train leave from?
Der Bus fährt um neun Uhr.
The bus leaves at nine o'clock.
der nächste Zug · die nächste Haltestelle
When does the next train leave?
der Zug fährt ab · wir fahren ab
Der Zug fährt um zehn Uhr ab.
The train departs at ten o'clock.
ich komme an · der Zug kommt an
Ich komme um elf Uhr an.
ich steige um · muss ich umsteigen?
Do I have to change in Cologne?
ich fahre · du fährst · der Zug fährt
Der Bus fährt in Richtung Bahnhof.
The bus goes in the direction of the station.
I will come ten minutes later.
I am waiting at the stop.
Haben Sie das in Größe M?
Do you have that in size M?
ich probiere an · kann ich das anprobieren?
Can I try the shirt on?
I would like to return the shirt.
ich tausche um · kann ich umtauschen?
I would like to collect a parcel.
ich hole ab · du holst ab
I am picking up the parcel.
I would like to send the parcel.
Die Post ist bis sechs Uhr offen.
The post office is open until six o'clock.
ich melde mich an · ich melde an
I am writing to the landlord.
Das Licht im Bad ist kaputt.
The light in the bathroom is broken.
Die Praxis ist bis fünf Uhr offen.
The practice is open until five o'clock.
Bitte bringen Sie Ihre Versicherungskarte mit.
ich bringe mit · was soll ich mitbringen?
es tut weh · mein Hals tut weh
Die Apotheke ist neben dem Bahnhof.
The pharmacy is next to the station.
My parents do not live here.
Shall we go to the cinema?
We are going to the cinema.
Shall we meet in the café?
die Abende; heute Abend = this evening
Tut mir leid, heute geht es nicht.
I am sorry, today does not work.
Yesterday I was in the park.
ich bin · ich war · ich bin gewesen
usually singular; Spaß haben = to have fun
Die Vorlesung beginnt um zehn Uhr.
The lecture starts at ten o'clock.
ich sage ab · ich muss absagen
I have to cancel the appointment.
usually singular; Bescheid sagen = to let someone know
Mein Projekt war eine kleine App.
My project was a small app.
ich rufe zurück · können Sie zurückrufen?
I will send you a message.
You can reach me on Monday.

lessons.goal: Buy one ticket: say where you are going, choose single or return, and pay.
patterns: Eine Fahrkarte nach …, bitte.
A ticket to …, please.
Use nach with a town: nach Köln, nach Berlin. One short sentence is enough to start.
Einfach oder hin und zurück?
Single or return?
Answer with just the words you need: Hin und zurück, bitte.
dialogues: Hello! Where would you like to go?
Hin und zurück, bitte. Was kostet das?
Return, please. How much is that?
Good, I will pay by card.
Guten Tag. Eine Fahrkarte nach Berlin, bitte.
Hello. A ticket to Berlin, please.
practice: Ask for a ticket to a town you choose.
Where would you like to go?
variations: The ticket is for tomorrow, not today. Say so.
Buy two tickets instead of one.

lessons.goal: Find where your train or bus leaves and check the platform or stop.
patterns: Von welchem Gleis fährt der Zug?
Which platform does the train leave from?
Learn this as one useful question. The short form Welches Gleis? also works.
Wo ist die Haltestelle?
Where is the stop?
Use wo for a place. Repeat the answer back to check it: Gleis drei?
dialogues: Entschuldigung, von welchem Gleis fährt der Zug nach Köln?
Excuse me, which platform does the train to Cologne leave from?
Ja, genau. Die Treppe ist rechts.
Yes, exactly. The stairs are on the right.
Excuse me, where is the stop?
Gehen Sie geradeaus. Die Haltestelle ist links.
Go straight ahead. The stop is on the left.
Which bus goes to the station?
practice: Ask which platform your train leaves from.
Von welchem Gleis fährt der Zug?
Which platform does the train leave from?
You are looking for the bus.
variations: Ask which bus goes to the university.
Which bus goes to the university?
You did not hear the platform. Ask again politely.

lessons.goal: Ask when the next train leaves, whether you must change, and in which direction.
warmup: When does the next train leave?
patterns: Wann fährt der nächste Zug?
When does the next train leave?
Use nächste for the next one. For a bus: der nächste Bus.
Muss ich umsteigen?
Do I have to change?
umsteigen splits in a normal sentence: Ich steige in Köln um. After muss it stays at the end.
dialogues: Guten Tag. Wann fährt der nächste Zug nach Bonn?
Hello. When does the next train to Bonn leave?
Um vierzehn Uhr. Er fährt von Gleis zwei ab.
At 2 p.m. It departs from platform two.
Thank you. Then I will wait here.
Entschuldigung, fährt dieser Bus in Richtung Bahnhof?
Excuse me, does this bus go in the direction of the station?
Wann fährt der nächste Bus zum Bahnhof?
When does the next bus to the station leave?
In zehn Minuten, von der Haltestelle dort.
In ten minutes, from the stop over there.
practice: Ask when the next train leaves.
When does the next train leave?
Ask whether you need to change.
Der Zug fährt um vierzehn Uhr.
Check the direction of a bus.
Fährt dieser Bus in Richtung Bahnhof?
Does this bus go towards the station?
variations: Ask where you have to change.
Where do I have to change?
Ask when the train arrives, not when it leaves.
Der Zug fährt um zehn Uhr ab.
The train departs at ten o'clock.

lessons.goal: Say that you are delayed, give a short reason, and say when you will arrive.
patterns: Ich komme zehn Minuten später.
I will arrive ten minutes later.
Give the number of minutes. This is clearer than a long explanation.
Der Zug hat Verspätung.
The train is delayed.
Verspätung haben is the normal way to say something is late. For yourself, use Ich bin spät.
dialogues: Hello Lea, I will come later.
Zehn Minuten. Der Zug hat Verspätung.
Ten minutes. The train is delayed.
Okay, I will wait in the café.
Nein, tut mir leid. Mein Bus hat Verspätung.
No, I am sorry. My bus is delayed.
Um halb drei. Normalerweise bin ich pünktlich.
At half past two. I am normally on time.
It is all fine, see you later!
practice: Tell a friend you will be a little late.
I will come ten minutes later.
Give the reason in one short sentence.
Ich komme um drei Uhr an.
I will arrive at three o'clock.
variations: Your bus is delayed instead of your train.
Tell a colleague politely at work, using Sie.
Good morning, is everything all right?
Entschuldigung, ich komme zehn Minuten später.
Sorry, I will come ten minutes later.

lessons.goal: Ask for a size, ask to try something on, and say whether it fits.
warmup: Do you have that in M?
patterns: Haben Sie das in Größe …?
Do you have that in size …?
German shops use S, M, L and numbers. Point at the item and say das.
Es ist zu klein. / Es passt gut.
It is too small. / It fits well.
zu plus an adjective means too: zu klein, zu groß, zu teuer.
dialogues: Entschuldigung, haben Sie das Hemd in Größe M?
Excuse me, do you have this shirt in size M?
Of course. The changing room is over there.
Ja, bitte. Haben Sie die Jacke in L?
Yes, please. Do you have the jacket in L?
Danke. Leider ist sie zu klein.
Thank you. Unfortunately it is too small.
I will bring you size XL.
practice: Haben Sie das in Größe M?
Do you have that in size M?
Say that it does not fit.
variations: This time the item fits. Say so and finish politely.
Ja, es passt gut. Ich nehme es.
Yes, it fits well. I will take it.
Ask for a bigger size after trying it.
Ja, haben Sie das eine Größe größer?
Yes, do you have that one size bigger?

lessons.goal: Compare two items, say which you prefer, and give one simple reason.
patterns: Diese Jacke ist besser.
This jacket is better.
Use diese for the one in front of you. besser is the comparison of gut.
Die blaue ist billiger, aber die schwarze gefällt mir.
The blue one is cheaper, but I like the black one.
aber joins two short ideas. You can also compare with teurer (more expensive).
dialogues: Wir haben zwei Jacken in Ihrer Größe.
We have two jackets in your size.
Ich vergleiche gern. Was kosten sie?
I would like to compare. How much are they?
Diese kostet vierzig Euro, die andere sechzig.
This one costs forty euros, the other one sixty.
Die erste ist billiger. Welche Farbe haben Sie noch?
The first one is cheaper. Which other colours do you have?
Dann nehme ich die blaue. Sie ist besser.
Then I will take the blue one. It is better.
Which shirt do you think is better?
Das weiße ist schön, aber zu teuer.
The white one is nice, but too expensive.
Das blaue ist billiger und die Farbe ist gut.
The blue one is cheaper and the colour is good.
practice: Say which of two items is better.
Say that something is too expensive.
variations: Why are you taking the blue one?
Sie ist billiger, aber die Farbe ist auch gut.
It is cheaper, but the colour is also good.
A friend asks your opinion between two phones.
Dieses ist besser. Es ist nicht so teuer.
This one is better. It is not so expensive.

lessons.goal: Return or exchange something, give a short reason, and show your receipt.
warmup: I would like to return this.
patterns: Ich möchte das zurückgeben.
I would like to return this.
zurückgeben splits in a normal sentence: Ich gebe das Hemd zurück. After möchte it stays at the end.
Kann ich das umtauschen?
Can I exchange this?
Returning gets your money back; umtauschen swaps it for something else.
dialogues: Guten Tag. Ich möchte das Hemd zurückgeben.
Hello. I would like to return this shirt.
Entschuldigung, kann ich die Jacke umtauschen?
Excuse me, can I exchange the jacket?
practice: Say that you would like to return something.
I would like to return this.
Why would you like to return it?
Say that you have the receipt.
variations: Ask to exchange instead of return.
Would you like the money back?
You do not have the receipt. Say so politely.
Nein, tut mir leid. Ist das ein Problem?
No, I am sorry. Is that a problem?

lessons.goal: Collect or send a parcel, and give the information the counter asks for.
warmup: I would like to collect a parcel.
patterns: Ich möchte ein Paket abholen.
I would like to collect a parcel.
abholen is for picking something up; verschicken is for sending it off.
Meine Nummer ist …
My number is …
Read numbers slowly, in pairs if that helps. Ask Noch einmal, bitte? if you need the question repeated.
dialogues: Guten Tag. Ich möchte ein Paket abholen.
Hello. I would like to collect a parcel.
Sam Meyer. M – E – Y – E – R.
Sam Meyer. M – E – Y – E – R.
Guten Tag. Ich möchte dieses Paket verschicken.
Hello. I would like to send this parcel.
Ja, nach Berlin. Was kostet das?
Yes, to Berlin. How much does that cost?
practice: Say that you want to collect a parcel.
I would like to collect a parcel.
Ask the price of sending it.
You would like to send the parcel?
Yes. How much does that cost?
variations: Send the parcel rather than collect it.
I would like to send the parcel.
The counter asks for identification. Offer your name and address.
Ja. Mein Name ist Sam Meyer.
Yes. My name is Sam Meyer.

lessons.goal: Give your address, postcode, and phone number clearly enough to be written down.
patterns: Meine Adresse ist … , Hausnummer …
My address is …, house number …
German order is street then number: Lindenstraße 4. Say the street, then the number.
Meine Telefonnummer ist …
My phone number is …
Say digits in small groups and pause. If asked, spell the street: L – I – N – D – E – N.
dialogues: L – I – N – D – E – N. Hausnummer vier.
L – I – N – D – E – N. House number four.
practice: Give your street and house number.
variations: Spell your street name when asked.
L – I – N – D – E – N.
L – I – N – D – E – N.
Confirm a number that was read back wrongly.

lessons.goal: Ask whether a room is still available, how much the rent is, and how big it is.
patterns: Ist das Zimmer noch frei?
Is the room still available?
noch frei means still free. The same question works for a Wohnung (flat).
Wie hoch ist die Miete?
How much is the rent?
Rent uses wie hoch (how high). For things in a shop you still use Was kostet …?
dialogues: Guten Tag. Ist das Zimmer noch frei?
Hello. Is the room still available?
Und wie groß ist das Zimmer?
And how big is the room?
Guten Tag, ich suche ein Zimmer.
Hello, I am looking for a room.
From when do you need it?
Ab Oktober. Ist die Wohnung noch frei?
From October. Is the flat still available?
Ja. Die Miete ist vierhundert Euro.
Yes. The rent is four hundred euros.
practice: Ask whether the room is still available.
variations: Say from when you need the room.
Ab wann brauchen Sie das Zimmer?
From when do you need the room?
Ask about a flat instead of a single room.
Are you looking for a room?
I am looking for a small flat.

lessons.goal: Arrange a time to view a room and confirm the appointment.
warmup: Wann kann ich das Zimmer sehen?
When can I see the room?
patterns: Kann ich das Zimmer besichtigen?
Can I view the room?
besichtigen is the usual word for viewing a room or flat. After kann it goes to the end.
Passt Freitag um fünf Uhr?
Does Friday at five work?
Offer one concrete day and time. Confirm by repeating it at the end.
dialogues: Guten Tag. Kann ich das Zimmer besichtigen?
Hello. Can I view the room?
Ja, gern. Wann haben Sie Zeit?
Yes, gladly. When do you have time?
Also Freitag um fünf Uhr. Danke!
So Friday at five o'clock. Thank you!
Ja, bitte. Geht es am Montag?
practice: Ja, Montag um vier Uhr passt.
Yes, Monday at four o'clock works.
variations: The offered time does not suit you. Suggest another.
Leider nicht. Geht es am Dienstag?
Ask whether you need to register for the viewing.

lessons.goal: Report one problem at home clearly and ask for it to be repaired.
patterns: Die Heizung funktioniert nicht.
The heating does not work.
nicht comes after the verb. You can also say Die Heizung ist kaputt.
Können Sie das reparieren?
Can you repair that?
After können the action word goes last. Add wann: Wann können Sie das reparieren?
dialogues: Guten Tag. Die Heizung funktioniert nicht.
Hello. The heating does not work.
Seit gestern. Es ist sehr kalt.
Since yesterday. It is very cold.
I will send someone on Monday.
Danke. Können Sie das bitte schnell reparieren?
Thank you. Can you repair it quickly, please?
Hallo, das Licht im Bad ist kaputt.
Hello, the light in the bathroom is broken.
Nein, die Dusche funktioniert auch nicht.
No, the shower does not work either.
practice: Report that the heating does not work.
Guten Tag, was ist das Problem?
variations: Report the shower instead of the heating.
Write a short message to your landlord.
You are writing to the landlord.
Guten Tag, das Licht im Bad ist kaputt.
Hello, the light in the bathroom is broken.

lessons.goal: Book a doctor's appointment and say how soon you need it.
patterns: Ich brauche einen Termin.
I need an appointment.
One short sentence is enough to start. Add beim Arzt if you need to be specific.
Es ist dringend.
It is urgent.
Use this only when it is true. Otherwise say Es ist nicht dringend.
dialogues: Guten Tag. Ich brauche einen Termin.
Am Dienstag, bitte. Es ist dringend.
On Tuesday, please. It is urgent.
Guten Tag, wie können wir helfen?
Ich möchte einen Termin beim Arzt.
I would like an appointment with the doctor.
Sind Sie zum ersten Mal hier?
Is this your first time here?
Ja. Haben Sie etwas am Freitag?
Yes. Do you have something on Friday?
practice: Say that you need an appointment.
Give a day that works for you.
variations: Say that it is not urgent.
Wir haben erst nächste Woche Zeit.
We only have time next week.
Haben Sie etwas früher? Es ist dringend.
Do you have something earlier? It is urgent.

lessons.goal: Check what to bring to an appointment and when to arrive.
patterns: Was soll ich mitbringen?
What should I bring?
soll asks for instructions. mitbringen goes to the end after soll.
Wann soll ich kommen?
When should I come?
Use the same pattern for time: Wann soll ich da sein?
dialogues: Ich habe eine Frage. Was soll ich mitbringen?
I have a question. What should I bring?
Bitte bringen Sie Ihre Versicherungskarte mit.
Ihr Termin ist am Freitag um elf Uhr.
Your appointment is on Friday at eleven o'clock.
Habe ich noch eine Frage… Wo ist die Praxis?
I have one more question… where is the practice?
practice: Say that you have one more question.
variations: Check whether you need to bring anything at all.

lessons.goal: Say what hurts, since when, and one extra detail.
patterns: Mein … tut weh.
My … hurts.
Use mein Hals, mein Kopf, mein Bauch. For several places: Meine Beine tun weh.
Ich habe Fieber / Husten.
I have a fever / a cough.
With haben you do not need an article here. Ich bin krank is a useful general sentence.
dialogues: Mein Hals tut weh und ich habe Husten.
My throat hurts and I have a cough.
variations: Your stomach hurts instead of your throat.
Tell a colleague you are ill, informally.

lessons.goal: Ask for something for a symptom, check how to take it, and ask the price.
warmup: Do you have something for that?
patterns: Haben Sie etwas gegen Husten?
Do you have something for a cough?
gegen means against. Replace the symptom: gegen Kopfschmerzen, gegen Fieber.
Wie oft soll ich das nehmen?
How often should I take it?
Ask this before leaving. Useful answers: einmal / zweimal am Tag.
dialogues: Guten Tag. Haben Sie etwas gegen Husten?
Hello. Do you have something for a cough?
Wie oft soll ich das nehmen?
How often should I take it?
How much does the medicine cost?
Excuse me, I have a headache.
Do you also have a fever?
Danke. Dann bin ich hoffentlich bald wieder gesund.
Thank you. Then I will hopefully be healthy again soon.
practice: Ask for something for a cough.
Do you have something for a cough?
Ask how often to take it.
Wie oft soll ich das nehmen?
How often should I take it?
How much does the medicine cost?
variations: Ask for something for a headache.
Do you have something for a headache?
Ask whether you need a prescription.

lessons.goal: Say who is in your family, where they live, and ask the same back.
patterns: Ich habe einen Bruder / eine Schwester.
I have a brother / a sister.
einen with Bruder, eine with Schwester. For none: Ich habe keine Geschwister.
Meine Eltern wohnen in …
My parents live in …
Eltern is always plural, so the verb is wohnen. Use your real situation.
dialogues: Nein, meine Familie wohnt in Indien.
No, my family lives in India.
Ich habe eine Schwester. Sie studiert auch.
I have a sister. She is studying too.
Biologie. Und du? Hast du Geschwister?
Biology. And you? Do you have siblings?
practice: Say who is in your family.
And you? Do you have siblings?
variations: You have no siblings. Say so.
No, I do not have any siblings.
Say one extra detail about a sibling.

lessons.goal: Suggest an activity, propose a time, and agree on where to meet.
warmup: Shall we go to the cinema?
patterns: Wollen wir … gehen?
Shall we go …?
Wollen wir is a friendly suggestion. ins Kino, ins Café, in den Park.
Heute Abend oder morgen?
This evening or tomorrow?
Offer two options so the answer is easy. heute Abend = this evening.
dialogues: Shall we go to the cinema?
Der neue Film um acht Uhr.
The new film at eight o'clock.
This evening. Are you coming along?
Hast du morgen Zeit? Wollen wir ins Café gehen?
Do you have time tomorrow? Shall we go to a café?
practice: Shall we go to the cinema?
variations: Suggest a café instead of the cinema.
Shall we go to a café?

lessons.goal: Say no kindly, give a short reason, and offer another time.
patterns: Tut mir leid, heute passt es nicht.
I am sorry, today does not work.
Two short pieces: the apology, then the fact. You do not need a long explanation.
Vielleicht am Samstag?
Maybe on Saturday?
Always offer an alternative. vielleicht keeps it friendly and open.
dialogues: Wollen wir heute ins Kino gehen?
Shall we go to the cinema today?
Tut mir leid, heute passt es nicht.
I am sorry, today does not work.
Kein Problem. Wann hast du Zeit?
No problem. When do you have time?
Kommst du um sechs Uhr mit?
Will you come along at six o'clock?
Leider nicht. Ich habe einen Termin.
Unfortunately not. I have an appointment.
Später geht es. Um acht Uhr?
practice: Wollen wir heute ins Kino gehen?
Shall we go to the cinema today?
Tut mir leid, heute passt es nicht.
I am sorry, today does not work.
variations: You can come, but later. Say so.
Are you coming at six o'clock?
Später geht es. Um acht Uhr?
Decline politely at work, using Sie.
Tut mir leid, heute geht es leider nicht.
I am sorry, unfortunately today does not work.

lessons.goal: Say what you did yesterday in two or three short sentences.
warmup: Yesterday I was in the park.
patterns: Gestern war ich …
Yesterday I was …
war is the past of bin. Starting with Gestern puts the verb next: Gestern war ich müde.
Ich habe … gemacht. / Ich bin … gegangen.
I did … / I went …
Most verbs use habe plus a participle at the end. Movement verbs use bin: Ich bin ins Kino gegangen.
dialogues: Sehr gut. Das hat Spaß gemacht.
Am Samstag war ich im Park.
On Saturday I was in the park.
Mit einem Freund. Es war ein schöner Tag.
With a friend. It was a nice day.
practice: Yesterday I was in the park.
Give a short opinion about it.
Es war schön. Das hat Spaß gemacht.
It was nice. That was fun.
variations: Talk about last Saturday instead of yesterday.
Was hast du am Samstag gemacht?
What did you do on Saturday?
Am Samstag war ich im Café.
On Saturday I was in a café.
Say that yesterday was quiet, and why.
Nein, ich war müde. Ich war zu Hause.
No, I was tired. I was at home.

lessons.goal: Ask when a lecture is, when the deadline is, and confirm what matters.
patterns: Wann ist die Abgabe?
When is the deadline?
The same pattern works for die Prüfung and die Vorlesung.
Ist das wichtig für die Prüfung?
Is that important for the exam?
A useful question in any course. für means for.
dialogues: Guten Tag, ich habe eine Frage. Wann ist die Abgabe?
Hello, I have a question. When is the deadline?
Ist die Abgabe wichtig für die Prüfung?
Is the deadline important for the exam?
Excuse me, when does the lecture start?
Um zehn Uhr, in Raum zwölf.
At ten o'clock, in room twelve.
Thank you. Is the lecture important?
Yes, the exam comes from it.
practice: Check whether something matters for the exam.
Ist das wichtig für die Prüfung?
Is that important for the exam?
variations: Ask whether the deadline can be extended.

lessons.goal: Explain that you were away or ill, apologise briefly, and say what you will do.
patterns: Leider war ich krank.
Unfortunately I was ill.
war is the past of bin. Starting with Leider keeps the verb next.
Ich sage Ihnen Bescheid.
I will let you know.
Bescheid sagen is a fixed expression. Use Ihnen with Sie and dir with du.
dialogues: Sie waren letzte Woche nicht da.
You were not here last week.
Ja, danke. Ist die Abgabe später möglich?
Yes, thank you. Is the deadline possible later?
Good, I will let you know.
Du warst gestern nicht im Kurs.
You were not in the class yesterday.
Nein, ich war beim Arzt. Ich musste absagen.
No, I was at the doctor. I had to cancel.
Yes, it is fine again now.
Gut. Ich schicke dir meine Notizen.
Good. I will send you my notes.
practice: Ask whether a later deadline is possible.
Say that you will let them know.
Good, I will let you know.
variations: You have to cancel a shift today. Tell your colleague.
Tut mir leid, ich muss heute absagen.
I am sorry, I have to cancel today.
Explain an absence informally to a classmate.
Ich war krank. Jetzt geht es wieder.
I was ill. It is fine again now.

lessons.goal: Describe one small project: what it was, what you used, and one difficulty.
patterns: Ich habe … gebaut / programmiert.
I built / programmed …
Use habe plus the participle at the end: Ich habe eine App gebaut.
Wir haben Python benutzt.
We used Python.
Name the real tools you used. For a team project use wir.
dialogues: Ich habe eine kleine App gebaut.
Sie zeigt Vokabeln. Ich habe Python benutzt.
It shows vocabulary. I used Python.
Ein Teil war schwierig, aber es hat funktioniert.
One part was difficult, but it worked.
Was hast du im Studium gemacht?
What did you do during your studies?
Wir haben zusammen eine Website gebaut.
practice: Say what you built or made.
Ich habe eine kleine App gebaut.
variations: Describe a team project with wir.
Describe a university project rather than code.

lessons.goal: Leave a short message: your name, why you are calling, and how to reach you.
patterns: Hier ist … Ich rufe wegen … an.
This is … I am calling about …
Start with your name. wegen means about: wegen dem Termin, wegen der Stelle.
Sie erreichen mich unter …
You can reach me on …
Give your number slowly, then repeat it once.
dialogues: Sie sprechen mit der Mailbox von Firma Nord.
You have reached the voicemail of Firma Nord.
Guten Tag, hier ist Sam Meyer.
Ich rufe wegen der Werkstudentenstelle an.
I am calling about the working-student job.
Can you call me back, please?
You can reach me on 0221 55 44. Thank you!
Guten Tag, hier ist Sam Meyer. Ist Frau Weber da?
Hello, this is Sam Meyer. Is Ms Weber there?
Nein, sie ist erst morgen wieder da.
No, she is only back tomorrow.
Bitte sagen Sie ihr, sie kann mich morgen erreichen.
